name: knowledge-base
description: Knowledge-base vault lint, Starlight MDX lint, and audit tooling.

scripts.lint:docs: bun run --cwd sites/docs check && bun run lint:mdx-wikilinks && bun run lint:mdx-table-wikilinks && bun run lint:mdx-link-hygiene --strict
scripts.lint:ci: bun run lint:ci:tooling && bun run lint:docs
scripts.lint:ci:tooling: bun run lint:wikilinks && bun run lint:publish-parity && bun run lint:aws-profile-consistency && bun run lint:mdx-recipe-context && bun run --cwd scripts/audit-notes lint:content && bun run --cwd scripts/audit-notes lint:mdx-content && bun run --cwd scripts/audit-notes lint:format
scripts.test:ci: bun run test && bun run --cwd scripts/audit-notes test
